name: GPSR for WooCommerce
author: WP Desk

sections.faq:
❔ Is GPSR for WooCommerce compatible with all WooCommerce themes?

✅ Yes, the plugin is designed to work seamlessly with most WooCommerce-compatible themes.

❔ Can I add custom fields in the GPSR tab?

⚙️ Currently, the plugin supports predefined fields. For advanced customization, you can modify the code or contact support.

❔ Does this plugin support multi-language websites?

🌍 Yes, the plugin is translation-ready and supports WordPress localization standards.

sections.description:
The GPSR for WooCommerce plugin is designed to help meet EU regulatory requirements, by adding fields for manufacturer, importer, and certifications.

🏛️ About the General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR)

The General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR) is a key piece of European Union legislation aimed at ensuring the safety of consumer products across the EU market. This regulation outlines strict requirements for businesses to provide detailed and transparent product information, including:

– ✅ Manufacturer and Importer Identification: Clearly identifying the manufacturer and, where applicable, the importer.
– 🛠️ Traceability: Providing essential product details that allow authorities and consumers to trace the origin of the product.
– 📄 Compliance Documentation: Ensuring that safety-related certifications and documents are easily accessible.
– 🌍 Consumer Protection: Offering clear and reliable information to safeguard the interests and well-being of customers.

🌟 Plugin overview

The GPSR for WooCommerce plugin is specifically designed to help online businesses meet these regulatory requirements. By adding fields for manufacturer details, importer information, and certifications, this plugin simplifies compliance while enhancing your store’s credibility.

Stay compliant and transparent with GPSR for WooCommerce! 🚀

✨ Key Features:

– 🛠️ Custom GPSR Product Tab: Adds a new “GPSR” tab in the WooCommerce product data section for easy customization.
– 📄 Enhanced Product Details: Allows you to input and display manufacturer, importer details and other critical product attributes required by European law.
– 🔄 WooCommerce Compatibility: Fully integrates with both simple and variable products.
– ✅ User-Friendly Interface: Designed to blend seamlessly into the WooCommerce admin panel for ease of use.

🎯 Why Use GPSR for WooCommerce?

  1. 💡 Improve Transparency: Display detailed product data directly on product pages, building trust with your customers.
  2. 📝 Enhance Product Descriptions: Include extra information about manufacturers, certifications, or specifications.
  3. 🔧 Customizable: Add, edit, or remove GPSR fields based on your business needs.

—

🛠️ Installation

  1. 📥 Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to your WordPress Admin Panel.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  4. Click Upload Plugin, select the ZIP file, and click Install Now.
  5. After installation, click Activate Plugin.

—

🚀 Usage Instructions

  1. Navigate to the product editor in WooCommerce.
  2. Locate the new GPSR tab in the product data section.
  3. Enter the relevant details (e.g., manufacturer name, certification codes, or other attributes).
  4. Save the product to display these details on the product page.

—

🔗 Additional Resources

  1. 📚 Learn More About GPSR WooCommerce
    Click here to read articles about GPSR WooCommerce

  2. 🛠️ Flexible Product Fields for WooCommerce
    Explore an alternative with more advanced custom field options

🌍 Roadmamp

🌐 We are on the way to compatibility GPSR for WooCommerce with Dropshipping XML WooCommerce to let you automatically import values to GPSR field from CSV and XML files.

—

📧 Support

For support and feature requests, please contact us at support@wpdesk.net.

💻 Start customizing your WooCommerce store today with GPSR for WooCommerce! 🚀

—
